expectations.text: Actually connects to the cluster and lists collections
expectations.evidence: Response shows cluster URL, lists all 12 collections in the inventory table, includes memory metrics from /metrics endpoint, and references actual API responses throughout.

expectations.text: Identifies the 10+ products-{locale} collections as an antipattern
expectations.evidence: Issue 1 'Redundant Locale Collections (High Impact)' identifies 11 separate locale-specific product collections and explicitly states 'The correct approach is a single products collection with a locale keyword field.'

expectations.text: Calculates or mentions the per-collection overhead (12-14 MB each)
expectations.evidence: The response does not mention the 12-14 MB per-collection overhead. It mentions per-collection segment overhead vaguely but does not cite the 12-14 MB figure. The closest reference is 'Segment + WAL overhead (12 collections x 2 segments each) ~5-10 MB (estimated)' which is not the correct per-collection overhead figure.

expectations.text: Recommends consolidating into a single collection with a tenant field
expectations.evidence: Recommendation 1: 'Consolidate locale collections into one (or few) collections' with example code showing a single products collection with locale keyword field and filtered search.

expectations.text: Checks collection config (on_disk, quantization) not just collection count
expectations.evidence: Collections inventory table shows on_disk status for each collection, quantization config. Issues 3 and 4 specifically discuss on_disk=false configuration and quantization config on embeddings-archive.
